articles.headline: Will Lankshear scores brace as Middlesbrough come back to survive scare and beat Lincoln
articles.description: Marquee signing Will Lankshear notched a second-half double as Middlesbrough fought back to kick off their Championship bid with a hard-fought 2-1 victory and inflict a first defeat in eight and a half months on newly promoted Lincoln.

images.credit: Bruce Rollinson/PA Images via Getty Images

images.name: Will Lankshear [1296x729]
images.caption: Will Lankshear scored his first Championship goal for Middlesbrough to level the scores.

articles.headline: Nestory Irankunda leaves Watford for Portuguese giants Sporting CP
articles.description: Australia international Nestory Irankunda will feature in the UEFA Champions League this season after joining Portuguese giants Sporting CP.

images.caption: Nestory Irankunda, who became Australia's youngest scorer at a men's World Cup back in June, has joined Portuguese giants Sporting CP after one season in the Championship with Watford.

articles.headline: Raúl Jiménez marks Wolves return by rescuing draw with Blackburn

articles.headline: Dastan Satpayev signs Chelsea deal, joins Burnley on loan

keyEvents.text: Nathaniel Phillips (West Bromwich Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Portsmouth 1, West Bromwich Albion 0. Conor Chaplin (Portsmouth) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Millenic Alli.
Mikey Johnston (West Bromwich Albion) is shown the yellow card.

Goal! Portsmouth 2, West Bromwich Albion 0. Millenic Alli (Portsmouth) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Andre Dozzell with a through ball following a fast break.
First Half ends, Portsmouth 2, West Bromwich Albion 0.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Josh Maja replaces Samuel Iling-Junior.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Callum Styles replaces Nathaniel Phillips.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Alfie Gilchrist replaces Danny Imray.
Goal! Portsmouth 3, West Bromwich Albion 0. Ebou Adams (Portsmouth) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Conor Chaplin with a through ball.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Jed Wallace replaces Mikey Johnston.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Keshi Anderson replaces Colby Bishop because of an injury.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Alex Mowatt replaces Jayson Molumby.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Marlon Pack replaces Adrian Segecic.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Makenzie Kirk replaces Millenic Alli.
Substitution, Portsmouth. John Swift replaces Ebou Adams.
Second Half ends, Portsmouth 3, West Bromwich Albion 0.
